conditioningLevel.rationale: High (provisional formula call): a rich architecture under W-RICH for conditioning, read with E3: prominent payload_lipid Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil@6 converging with prominent cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@9, plus Glyceryl Oleate@8 and a deliberate humectant route (Glycerin@12, Panthenol@13, Sodium Hyaluronate@18). Counter-signal: single cationic, no silicone, no pearlizer; moderate is the realistic neighbor.
